name: corescout
description: Operational memory for the machine your AI works on: what fails here, what has been verified, and what state the computer is in.
long_description:
CoreScout observes this computer and what AI tools do to it, notices what recurs, and tests the promising patterns under randomised assignment before it claims a cause. Claude can ask it what has failed here before, whether a verified procedure exists for an operation, and whether the machine is in an unusual state, and can report outcomes back so the next session starts from what this one learned.

Everything stays on the machine. There is no account, no server and no telemetry: the extension bundles the CoreScout service and talks to it over a loopback socket guarded by a token only your account can read.

tools.name: corescout_status
tools.description: Is CoreScout running, what is connected to it, and how much it has seen.

tools.name: corescout_briefing
tools.description: What CoreScout is, what it currently knows, and what it will and will not do in its present mode.

tools.name: corescout_knowledge
tools.description: Everything this computer has learned, grouped by AI tool, repository and machine.

tools.name: corescout_current_state
tools.description: What the machine is doing right now, and whether that state is one CoreScout recognises.

tools.name: corescout_machine
tools.description: What this computer physically is, and what CoreScout can observe of it.

tools.name: corescout_learned
tools.description: Learned findings as cards, each marked correlation or measured effect.

tools.name: corescout_failures
tools.description: Operations that recur and go wrong on this machine, with how often and how they fail.

tools.name: corescout_capabilities
tools.description: Procedures CoreScout has verified and the user has approved.

tools.name: corescout_hypotheses
tools.description: What CoreScout is currently testing and cannot yet answer.

tools.name: corescout_ask
tools.description: Ask CoreScout what it knows about a repository, an operation, or the machine's current state.

tools.name: corescout_explain
tools.description: Why CoreScout believes one thing: the evidence and how it was obtained.

tools.name: corescout_recent_activity
tools.description: What has happened recently, as CoreScout recorded it.

tools.name: corescout_before
tools.description: Check before an operation: its history here, and whether a better way is known.

tools.name: corescout_observe
tools.description: Report what you just did and how it went, including whether you verified the result.

tools.name: corescout_run_capability
tools.description: Run a verified capability, subject to the user's autonomy mode and permissions.
